observations: Black metal filing cabinet with three sections.
Top section is a safe with a combination dial and a key lock.
Two standard filing drawers are located below the safe.
The word 'SWITCH' is printed on the top left corner of the unit.
Keys are visible in the safe door and the middle drawer lock.
The unit is surrounded by other grey and white filing cabinets, suggesting a showroom or warehouse setting.
A watermark for 'KACHITECH FURNITURE' is visible across the center.

claims.evidence: Physical strength and gauge of metal cannot be determined from a single front-facing photo.

risks.risk: The safe combination may be lost or the mechanical dial may be jammed.
risks.proof: A video showing the safe being opened using both the dial and the key.
risks.if_unproven: as a cabinet with a locked/unusable safe compartment

risks.risk: Drawer runners may be damaged, causing drawers to stick or fall off tracks.
risks.proof: A video showing both drawers being pulled out to full extension and closed.
risks.if_unproven: as having damaged or jammed drawers

risks.risk: Significant rust or structural damage may exist on the sides or back not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of the back and both side panels.
risks.if_unproven: as having significant surface rust and dents

proof_requests: Video of the safe being operated (dial and key) to prove it functions.
Video of the lower drawers opening and closing to check the rails.
Photos of the side and rear panels to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Switch brand filing cabinet with an integrated safe. While internal functionality is unproven, it can be priced based on its visible condition as a used office unit.
